d: The Executive, Workplace Technology, is responsible for providing timely and effective technical support to company employees, ensuring smooth operation of all hardware, software, and network systems. This role is central to maintaining productivity by troubleshooting IT issues, implementing solutions, and supporting IT infrastructure. The Executive will also collaborate with the IT team on various initiatives to enhance the organization’s technology landscape and deliver a positive, reliable user experience.
Respond to hardware-specific issues related to physical devices like computers, printers, and mobile devices.
Install, configure, and repair hardware and peripherals, ensuring device functionality.
Assist in setting up and maintaining network hardware (e.g., routers, switches).
Troubleshoot basic network connectivity issues, escalating advanced problems to the network team.
Maintain inventory of physical IT hardware assets.
Track the usage and condition of hardware; assist in software compliance as needed.
Support hardware-focused projects, such as device upgrades and deployments.
Assist in hardware aspects of larger IT projects, coordinating with ICT for software elements.
Work with technical staff on hardware issues, escalating software or complex issues to ICT.
Provide training on hardware equipment, including device care and basic troubleshooting.
Develop hardware-focused guides for user assistance.
Stay updated on hardware trends, device advancements, and peripheral compatibility.
Recommend new hardware tools or devices to improve system performance.
Address a full range of IT support issues, including hardware, software, and network troubleshooting.
Resolve both device-level and application-level issues for integrated IT support.
Oversee network infrastructure, managing configurations and security for reliable connectivity.
Conduct advanced network troubleshooting, coordinating with specialized teams as necessary.
Manage both hardware and software assets, ensuring compliance with software licensing.
Coordinate with vendors on software renewals and organizational policy alignment.
Lead or coordinate IT projects, including software rollouts and network expansions.
Assess project requirements, plan resources, and ensure smooth transitions in alignment with organizational IT strategy.
Collaborate with both hardware and software specialists, resolving complex technical issues.
Escalate only high-level issues, leveraging internal and external resources for solutions.
Conduct training on software, IT policies, and security protocols, covering both hardware and software knowledge.
Create comprehensive guides for users, covering IT equipment and application use.
Stay informed on broad IT advancements, exploring new software, network technologies, and security practices.
Recommend technology strategies to enhance system efficiency and user experience.

The successful candidate will contribute to the planning, development, delivery, facilitation, and assessment of Anatomy teaching within the undergraduate medical programmes at RCSI-MUB, ensuring high standards of teaching and learning.

They will assist with the delivery of the RCSI curriculum in the multicultural environment of RCSI-MUB, will liaise with RCSI Dublin on curriculum delivery, examinations and research matters, ensuring academic quality and consistency across the RCSI campuses. RCSI is seeking a professional who is passionate about research and teaching, would like to experience working as an academic in a multicultural environment, and demonstrates initiative, openness and resilience.
q: A PhD in Anatomy or a related anatomical or biomedical discipline (e.g. Neuroanatomy, Embryology, Histology or Developmental Biology), or a medical degree with a relevant postgraduate qualification, supported by a strong foundation in human anatomy.
Sound knowledge of human anatomy, with the ability to teach relevant anatomical concepts in the context of undergraduate medical education.
Ability to integrate anatomical knowledge with clinical applications and other relevant biomedical disciplines.

Experience in teaching Anatomy or related biomedical subjects, with the ability to deliver effective teaching across a range of educational settings, including lectures, small-group tutorials and practical sessions.
Understanding of assessment principles, with the ability to contribute to the development, delivery and evaluation of student assessments.
Commitment to providing constructive feedback, academic guidance and support to students with diverse learning needs.
Willingness to contribute to curriculum delivery, development, review and continuous quality improvement.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex anatomical concepts clearly and effectively.
Ability to work collaboratively and collegially within multidisciplinary teaching teams.
Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage teaching responsibilities, meet deadlines and contribute to departmental activities.
Demonstrated professionalism, integrity, adaptability and commitment to maintaining a positive and inclusive learning environment.
Commitment to continuing professional development and maintaining currency in anatomical knowledge and educational practices.
Evidence of engagement or interest in educational scholarship, pedagogical innovation or research relevant to Anatomy, medical education or related disciplines.
Peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations or other scholarly contributions in Anatomy, medical education or related fields.
Experience in the use or development of innovative teaching approaches, including technology-enhanced learning, simulation, three-dimensional visualisation or other digital anatomy platforms.
Experience in academic advising, student mentoring or supporting student academic development.
Previous involvement in academic committees, quality assurance activities or educational accreditation processes.
r: Participating in the administration and delivery of current teaching programmes, teaching modalities and assessment in anatomy for undergraduate students.
Contributing to the development and introduction of new teaching programmes, teaching modalities and modes of assessment.
Liaising with colleagues across RCSI international campuses in the facilitation of research and teaching activities.
Undergoing programmes of training and development as may be required.
Undertaking overseas assignments as may be required from time to time.
Providing academic guidance, supervision, and support to undergraduate students throughout their learning journey.
Participating in the development of RCSI’s teaching and learning strategy, including the effective use of technology-enhanced learning.
Contributing to quality assurance/quality improvement and accreditation of existing modules.
Performing such other related duties as may be required.
Participate in public engagement, science communication, and school outreach activities.
Representing the best interests of the Department and RCSI at all times.

The Senior Manager Tax – MENAT will provide specialist support for VAT compliance, transformation and risk management across GCC sites. This role will help enhance end-of-the-end VAT processes, improve data quality, standardise execution, strengthen controls, increase automation and ensure accurate and timely compliance.

The role will also support international tax, transfer pricing and internal M&A matters, working collaboratively with stakeholders across Tax, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk and the business.
q: A graduation degree is essential for obtaining a visa and work permit. If your university certificate is from outside the UAE, up-to-date attestations and equivalency are also mandatory (Recognition of Higher Education Qualifications Issued Outside The UAE).
A professional qualification in tax, accounting, finance or law is required. Chartered Accountant, CPA, ACCA, CTA or equivalent qualifications are strongly preferred.
Significant tax experience, including deep practical expertise in VAT across GCC jurisdictions.
Significant experience with the Big Four firms and strong tax experience within financial services, preferably banking.
Experience engaging with tax authorities and managing VAT audits, disputes, appeals or litigation support.
Sound knowledge of corporate tax, transfer pricing, international tax, tax treaties, permanent establishment, withholding tax and tax accounting.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, practical advice to senior stakeholders.
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret financial, transactional and operational data.
Experience using technology and automation to improve tax processes, controls and reporting.
Good project-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and manage competing priorities.
A collaborative and delivery-focused approach, with sound judgement, integrity and the confidence to challenge constructively.
Ability to work effectively across functions and locations in a complex, highly regulated organisation.
Commitment to HSBC’s values, policies, risk-management standards, confidentiality and information-security requirements.
For further details and application information, please visit our careers site and search using reference number 65042.
r: Lead the enhancement and transformation of VAT compliance processes across GCC sites.
Standardise VAT processes, improve source data and reconciliations, strengthen controls and enhance management reporting.
Lead or support VAT regulatory and transformation projects, including e-invoicing implementation.
Assess process, control, data and technology requirements and support testing and business implementation.
Monitor VAT legislation and business developments, assessing their impact on processes, systems and controls.
Provide practical VAT advice on new products, business initiatives, entity changes, systems and operating-model developments.
Manage VAT risk and support tax authority engagements, including audits, assessments, information requests, rulings, voluntary disclosures and disputes.
Support the remediation of VAT compliance and control issues, ensuring clear actions, ownership and timely follow-up.
Support international tax and transfer pricing matters, including cross-border and intercompany arrangements, permanent establishment, treaty and withholding tax considerations.
Provide specialist tax support for internal acquisitions, disposals, restructurings and other M&A transactions.
Manage relationships with external compliance partners and professional advisers, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery.
Build effective relationships across Tax, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk and the business, communicating complex tax matters clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
